title: MOD_11_2.compute(X-in-body) raises raw ValueError instead of ISO7064Error
spec_violation: SPEC §6 AC9: All systems raise ISO7064Error on invalid input.
minimization_method: manual (4 bytes is the minimum length required for MOD_11_2 to dispatch _check_character_impl; 1-3 byte inputs bypass the bug entirely or hit length-validation paths)
discovery_source: manual audit (VULN_AUDIT T1) + fuzzer reproduction on T2/T3 runs
crash_classification: exception_propagation (ValueError not caught + re-raised as ISO7064Error)
exploitability: trivial — any caller passing ISBN-style data with 'X' before the check-character position
impact: exception handlers catching only ISO7064Error will skip this error; retry/backoff logic may break; stack traces may leak to logs
remediation_hint: wrap _Mod11_2._check_character_impl in try/except ValueError -> raise ISO7064Error from ...
